title: Other colonies
summary: Some regions hold other colonies, in their own colours. Each can be neutral, hostile or allied.
text:
Out across the system, you'll find you aren't the only newcomers. Some regions hold **other colonies**: their buildings, drones and units drawn in their own colour, on the ground and on the radar map.

Each stands with you in one of three ways:

- **Neutral**: they don't fight you, and your guns leave them alone
- **Hostile**: they fight, and so do you
- **Allied**: they fight beside you (you can't command them)

The log says whenever one changes its mind about you.
